summary: The accessible author results describe disrupted rhythms and expression at individual sampling times. Science lists Data S1–S8, but the publisher and public mirrors did not deliver those files, so agreement with the registered across-time genotype effect remains unassessed. The proposal passed validation, and the audit verified all 53 source files indexed in SOURCES.tsv.
openIssues: The final Data S1–S8 and two PMC supplement PDFs remain uninspected. Whether the authors reported a pooled ARC HepDKO-versus-control effect is unknown.

The registry time-series description needs correction. GEO and the paper identify hepatocyte-specific REV-ERBα/β deletion and three pooled ARC libraries per arm per time point. The exact donor count per pool is unresolved. [GEO series](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE248462) · [Published study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39509517/)
